title: Wound Care Supply Program Patient Account Terms
content:
# Patient account terms — Wound Care Supply Program

Patient Financial Services applies the following terms to customer balances on each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program.

## Payment plans

An interest-free payment plan is defined by three figures: the smallest patient balance for which a plan may be requested, the longest plan in monthly installments (0 means payment plans are not offered on the tier), and the smallest monthly installment accepted.

| Tier | Smallest balance for a plan | Longest plan | Smallest monthly installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | USD 150.00 | 0 months (not offered) | USD 25.00 |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | USD 150.00 | 6 months | USD 25.00 |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | USD 150.00 | 6 months | USD 25.00 |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | USD 100.00 | 10 months | USD 20.00 |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | USD 100.00 | 10 months | USD 20.00 |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | USD 100.00 | 0 months (not offered) | USD 20.00 |

## Write-offs, hardship and credit balances

- **Small-balance write-off**: the largest remaining patient balance, in USD, that is written off as a small balance instead of being statemented; 0.00 means no small-balance write-off on the tier.
- **Hardship waiver allowed**: whether a documented financial-hardship waiver of patient cost share may be granted case by case on the tier.
- **Hardship income ceiling**: the household income ceiling for a hardship waiver, as a whole percent of the current HHS federal poverty guideline for the household size.
- **Credit-balance refund limit**: the time limit for refunding a customer credit balance (overpayment), in calendar days counted from the posting date of the entry that created the credit.

| Tier | Small-balance write-off | Hardship waiver allowed | Hardship income ceiling | Credit-balance refund limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | USD 0.00 (none) | No | 200% | 30 days |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | USD 4.99 | Yes | 200% | 30 days |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | USD 4.99 | Yes | 200% | 30 days |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | USD 4.99 | Yes | 200% | 60 days |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | USD 0.00 (none) | Yes | 200% | 60 days |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | USD 0.00 (none) | No | 200% | 60 days |

## Reading the terms

- Payment plans exist on four tiers; the Wound Care Self-Pay Program and the Wound Care Medicaid Program show 0 months.
- The small-balance write-off of USD 4.99 exists on the commercial HMO, commercial PPO and Medicare Advantage tiers only.
- The hardship income ceiling is 200% on every tier, but a hardship waiver may be granted only where the tier shows Yes.
